comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
The Flame/Thunder King Charms are non-tradable, and be aware that Atlantis has no bank clerk or shared storage NPC (you cant even access ganador base from there), so your need to hop between ports for money and item withdraw/deposit. If you have the Master of Ancient Technologies title, that will help quite a bit cutting down the trips.

For Atlantis location this week: 14773,2849 in the North Atlantic Ocean, just north of The Azores.

Goods accepted by the Store Keeper: foodstuff, precious metals, and ores.

comments.body: Regarding banks, just use Lost Ancient Celestial Globe to teleport to/from Atlantis and the city of your choice after unlocking it with the Solar Barge for the week. Easier that way.

Please go to ▶ Acropolis of Atlantis


HOW TO REACH ATLANTIS
----------------
Quests In Common
(Adventure / Merchant / Maritime)
----------------

1. Land of the Legendary King

2. Quest Chain (You have to do all 3 quests below!)

1) Egypt and Atlantis
Required Condition: Adventure Fame 10K or higher
Note: Doesn't have Discovery, Available Just Once!

2) A Chance Meeting on the Sea of Atlas
Note: Doesn't have Discovery, Available Just Once!

3) Aspiring a Pure World (NOT London Adventure Guild!)
Note: Doesn't have Discovery, Available Just Once!

--------------------
☞ Now you completed Quests in common, you can select one of 3 routes and do.
--------------------

3-1. Adventure Job (Tradescant's Route)

Those Who Seek and Those Who Lead

You can pull Secret Edict Quests to build a Solar Barge at your palace(Secretary) or Merchant GM after finishing this quest.
--------------------

3-2. Merchant Job (Alvero's Route)

Required Condition: Port permit of East Asia

A Certain Merchant's Misgivings
A Lord and a Merchant

You can pull Secret Edict Quests to build a Solar Barge at your palace(Secretary) or Merchant GM after finishing these two quests.
---------------------

3-3. Maritime Job (Morgan's Route)
This route is highly recommdended cause it is easy to complete.

Required Condition: Maritime Fame 10K or higher
Dangerous Caribbean

You can pull Secret Edict Quests to build a Solar Barge at your palace(Secretary) or Merchant GM after finishing this quest. (fin.)


NOTE: You don't need to do Secret Edict Quests in case you have Secret Edict Completion Report - see its page for details

----------------
STRESS TEST FOR ANCIENT TECH. RESEARCH
----------------

Ancient Tech. Research....................Strong....................Weak
1. Mysterious Ore..............Water / Fire............Impact
2. Mysterious Weapon.......Impact...................Water / Fire
3. Mysterious Food............Water / Fire............Impact
4. Mysterious Fabric..........Water / Impact.......Fire
5. Mysterious Medicine......Impact...................Water / Fire

NOTE: It seems that the success rate of Mysterious Weapon/Medicine is higher than that of My.Ore/Food/Fabric cause the former have just one strong element and the latter have two elements. Please regard this note as the experiences rather than the verified info.

----------------
BLESSING
----------------

During Atlantis period, you can earn Crystal of Blessing for certain actions, up to max of x5 per day! Conditions to receive Crystal of Blessing are:

1. Poseidon's Blessing: Visit/exit the Temple of Poseidon
2. Ares' Blessing Clear 10 Sections in Labyrinth / the Poseidon Dungeon
3. Athena's Blessing: Defeat a Ganador (any Ganador works other than Maymay!)
4. Metis' Blessing: Make progress in Ancient Technology Research (50 pts. minimum required)
5. Hephaestus' Blessing: Make "Success" in Transmutation Alchemy ( Wind of Return is recommended)
